text:
Subject: A gentle reminder regarding our meeting schedule

Hi there,

I hope you are having a lovely day. I wanted to touch base regarding our recent client meetings. It is really important that we present a polished and professional image to our clients, and punctuality plays a big part in that.

I have noticed that you have been arriving a bit late to a few of these sessions recently. I know that life can be busy and unpredictable, but this pattern needs to shift so we can maintain our high standards. Please make sure to plan your travel time carefully to ensure you are on time for future engagements.

On a lighter note, while we are thinking about the weather and timing, it is always nice to look up and see the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from. They are quite peaceful to watch, aren't they?

Thank you for your attention to this matter and for your continued hard work.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
